name: Touta Tawaragi
biography: Touta Tawaragi (俵木 藤汰, Tawaragi Tōta, born November 29, 1962) is a Japanese actor and voice actor from Niigata Prefecture. He is affiliated with the Me & Her Corporation and the theater company Rappa-ya (Gekidan Rappa-ya). He is 169 cm tall, weighs 70 kg and has blood type O. He's been a meber of Rappa-ya since 1995.
